name: Puvanan Mogan
subject: AMDAL & ESIA report services for pulp mill in West Kalimantan Indonesia
message:
To whom it may concern,

My company, Chemone Holdings Pte Ltd, a Singapore registered entity is currently developing a pulp mill in West Kalimantan Indonesia and we are in need to conduct a AMDAL, ESIA report for our project hence I am reaching out to your company to know more about your services. I will be able to divulge more details once an NDA is signed so please connect me to your business development team so that I can discuss this oppoutunity further.

Thank you.

Best Regards,
Puvanan Mogan
